message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Xiong (邢某) was accountant, cash custodian. He was entrusted to keep and disburse land compensation funds (100.016万元). He misappropriated 30万元 (i.e., embezzlement). He borrowed with Jiang (江某甲) and later Jiang returned 30万元 from another source. So the crime is "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds) or "挪用特定款物罪"? Since the funds are land compensation funds from government, likely public funds. Under Chinese Criminal Law, Article 382 (挪用公款罪) applies to state employees or persons entrusted with public funds. He was a village accountant, entrusted with public funds. So crime: "挪用公款罪". Also possibly "受贿罪"? No, he didn't receive bribe. So single crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]挪用公款罪<eoa>
